name: alur-agent
description: Local-first Firefox automation assistant for the ALUR pseudocode lab

scripts.smoke:openrouter: bash -c 'if [ -z "$OPENROUTER_API_KEY" ]; then echo "UNVERIFIED: OPENROUTER_API_KEY not configured"; exit 0; fi; echo "Live smoke: OPENROUTER_API_KEY present; run optional manual test"; node -e "const key = process.env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY; if (!key || !key.startsWith("sk-")) { console.log("UNVERIFIED: key missing or invalid format"); process.exit(0); } console.log("Smoke test: key format ok, model=openrouter/free; manual verification required");"'
